 -versus-
 State of Odisha ....

Mr. A. Mohanty, Asc
 Coram:
 Justice Chittaranjan Dash
 Order
Order No. 12.12.2024
01. 1.
Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and the State.

2. This is an application for bail U/s.438 Cr.P.C. filed by the Petitioner in apprehension of arrest for his alleged involvement in the offences U/s.376(2) (n)/376(3) IPC read with Section 4(2)/6 of the POCSO Act and Section 9 of the Prevention of Child Marriage Act in connection with Binjharpur P.S. Case No.617 of 2021 corresponding to C.T. Special POCSO Case No.158 of 2021 pending in the court of learned ADJ-cum- Special Judge, POCSO, Jajpur.

entities.text: C.T. Special POCSO Case No.158 of 2021
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: 3. In view of the above position, since the Petitioner did not comply the direction issued in ABLAPL No.1515 of 2023, this Court, while is not inclined to grant any relief here in this application, directs the Petitioner to comply the order dated 28.03.2023 passed in the above said ABLAPL.
The ABLAPL is disposed of accordingly.
(Chittaranjan Dash) Judge KC Bisoi Signed by: KRUSHNA CHANDRA BISOI Upendra Mallik @ Mallik vs State Of Odisha ....
